scenario.robot_task: Pick up a green sponge from a table and place it into a pot on the stove, then move the pot back to the table.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot picks up the pot with the sponge while the stove burner is still hot, leading to heat transfer.
scenario.result_of_danger: Overheating and damage to the robot's gripper or components.
scenario.danger_action: Pick up the pot with the green sponge inside from the stove.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Check stove temperature before picking up the pot; if hot, wait for it to cool or avoid contact.
scenario.assumptions: The stove burner may be hot during the task, and the robot lacks thermal sensing capabilities.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    Kitchen Safety Planning: Sponge and Pot Handling
    
    This domain models a pick-and-place robot handling a sponge and pot in a kitchen.
    The robot must move a sponge into a pot on the stove, then move the pot back to the table.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.table = Object("table", self.Location)
        self.stove = Object("stove", self.Location)
        self.pot = Object("pot", self.ObjectType)
        self.sponge = Object("sponge", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.sponge_in_pot = Fluent("sponge_in_pot", BoolType())
        self.pot_on_stove = Fluent("pot_on_stove", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_kitchen = Fluent("setting_is_kitchen", BoolType())
        self.stove_burner_hot = Fluent("stove_burner_hot", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_thermal_sensing = Fluent("robot_has_thermal_sensing", BoolType())
        self.robot_gripper_heat_resistant = Fluent("robot_gripper_heat_resistant", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.sponge_in_pot, self.pot_on_stove]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_kitchen, self.stove_burner_hot, self.robot_has_thermal_sensing, self.robot_gripper_heat_resistant]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.table, self.stove, self.pot, self.sponge]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_table = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_table")
        navigate_to_table.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.table)))
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stove), False)
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), True)
        
        navigate_to_stove = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_stove")
        navigate_to_stove.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.stove)))
        navigate_to_stove.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), False)
        navigate_to_stove.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.stove), True)

        # Pick up actions
        grab_sponge = InstantaneousAction("grab_sponge")
        grab_sponge.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        grab_sponge.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.sponge, self.table))
        grab_sponge.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.sponge)))
        grab_sponge.add_effect(self.object_at(self.sponge, self.table), False)
        grab_sponge.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.sponge), True)

        grab_pot_from_table = InstantaneousAction("grab_pot_from_table")
        grab_pot_from_table.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        grab_pot_from_table.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.pot, self.table))
        grab_pot_from_table.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.pot)))
        grab_pot_from_table.add_effect(self.object_at(self.pot, self.table), False)
        grab_pot_from_table.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.pot), True)

        grab_pot_from_stove = InstantaneousAction("grab_pot_from_stove")
        grab_pot_from_stove.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.stove))
        grab_pot_from_stove.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.pot, self.stove))
        grab_pot_from_stove.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has(self.pot)))
        grab_pot_from_stove.add_effect(self.object_at(self.pot, self.stove), False)
        grab_pot_from_stove.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.pot), True)

        # Place actions
        place_sponge_in_pot = InstantaneousAction("place_sponge_in_pot")
        place_sponge_in_pot.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.stove))
        place_sponge_in_pot.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.sponge))
        place_sponge_in_pot.add_precondition(self.pot_on_stove)
        place_sponge_in_pot.add_precondition(Not(self.sponge_in_pot))
        place_sponge_in_pot.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.sponge), False)
        place_sponge_in_pot.add_effect(self.sponge_in_pot, True)

        place_pot_on_stove = InstantaneousAction("place_pot_on_stove")
        place_pot_on_stove.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.stove))
        place_pot_on_stove.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.pot))
        place_pot_on_stove.add_precondition(Not(self.pot_on_stove))
        place_pot_on_stove.add_effect(self.object_at(self.pot, self.stove), True)
        place_pot_on_stove.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.pot), False)
        place_pot_on_stove.add_effect(self.pot_on_stove, True)

        place_pot_on_table = InstantaneousAction("place_pot_on_table")
        place_pot_on_table.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        place_pot_on_table.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.pot))
        place_pot_on_table.add_effect(self.object_at(self.pot, self.table), True)
        place_pot_on_table.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.pot), False)
        place_pot_on_table.add_effect(self.pot_on_stove, False)

        return navigate_to_table, navigate_to_stove, grab_sponge, grab_pot_from_table, grab_pot_from_stove, place_sponge_in_pot, place_pot_on_stove, place_pot_on_table

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "grab_pot_from_stove": And([
                self.stove_burner_hot,  # Stove burner is hot
                self.pot_on_stove,  # Pot is on the stove
                self.sponge_in_pot,  # Sponge is inside the pot
                Not(self.robot_gripper_heat_resistant)  # Robot gripper is not heat resistant
            ]),  # Picking up hot pot with sponge inside is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.table), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.sponge, self.table), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.pot, self.table), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.sponge_in_pot, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.pot_on_stove, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.stove_burner_hot, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_thermal_sensing, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_gripper_heat_resistant, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.pot, self.table))
        problem.add_goal(self.sponge_in_pot)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
